verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is built to run untrusted or agent-generated code in isolated environments. Each sandbox gets its own VM or container with a full Linux environment, and the SDK can intercept outbound HTTP via Workers, so an agent can execute and test code walled off from production systems. However, the docs do not explicitly frame this as test-versus-production data separation. Bindings to KV/R2/Durable Objects could reach real data unless the user scopes them, and a community user notes outbound network control looks all-or-nothing. missing for 10: explicit guidance or features for isolating test data from production (e.g., scoped or mock bindings, seeded test datasets), documented fine-grained egress restrictions, independent hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees.
